messages:
Maya: Kickoff notes from this morning's health check — summarizing actions for SLA alignment and evidence we need for the customer acceptance packet.

Maya: Customer (Jordan / CareWorks) sees intermittent latency > 1.2s for embed endpoints during peak. We flagged renewal risk if we can't show recent SLO compliance. Need: uptime % last 30d, p50/p95/p99 latency for text-gen and embed, traffic heatmap, and any mitigation timeline.

Jordan: Yep, confirmed. We saw 3 spikes last week around 09:00 UTC. Can you show how credits would be calculated? We're trying to prep our procurement folks.

Ravi: From infra — quick calc sketch: if monthly uptime < 99.9 -> credit = min( (99.9 - uptime) * monthly_commitment * 10, max_credit ). Example: uptime 99.6% on $10k/mo => (0.3%)*10k*10 = $300 => cap applies? we usually cap at 30%.

Ravi: To pull latency percentiles (internal):
```
# promql on metrics cluster
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_latency_seconds_bucket{service="embed"}[30d])) by (le))
```

Maya: I'll produce the evidence bundle: uptime report (CSV), latency percentiles, and the traffic heatmap export. Planning to attach to the customer packet and to the renewal thread.

Olivia: Can we schedule a 30m enablement walkthrough for CareWorks' SRE + procurement? I can run the credit calc and show mitigation timeline.

Maya: Proposed slots: Tue 10am PT, Wed 2pm PT. Jordan which works?

Jordan: Wed 2pm PT works. Also: can you include the warmstart/cache suggestions we discussed? That reduced p95 by ~40% in our test.

Ravi: Noted — will include warmstart hit rate and batching params. Quick note: there's a config change we can roll (batching window from 4ms -> 8ms) that reduces p95 at cost of tail for tiny requests. We'll document tradeoffs.

ops-bot: evidence-bundle-uploaded: https://files.redwood.ai/evidence/1719955555_careworks_bundle.zip

Maya: Received, thanks @ops-bot. Next steps: (1) I will attach the CSV + TLDR and credit calc to the customer packet (due EOD Thu), (2) Olivia to run the enablement session Wed 2pm, (3) Ravi to prepare config change note and rollback plan. Marking renewal risk as 'watch' not 'red' for now. :eyes:

Jordan: Thanks team. Appreciate the transparency. :thumbsup:

Maya: I'll post a short digest in renewal-runbook after session.
